sections.title: Acceptance criteria
sections.content:
- The site includes a menu page
- The site includes an order form
- The site includes a contact page
- The look is modern but also traditional (to confirm)
- The site is delivered before the holiday season (to confirm)
- The work fits a budget of around $3,000

sections.title: Deliverables
sections.content:
- menu page
- order form
- contact page

sections.title: Open gaps
sections.content: The target audience is not stated; the client should confirm it.

sections.title: Open issues and questions
sections.content:
- [medium] ambiguity: "Modern but also traditional" can be read several ways and gives no usable design direction.
- [high] timeline_risk: "Before the holiday season" gives no concrete launch date.
- [medium] scope_risk: Online cake ordering may imply payment processing and order management, which the brief does not mention.
- Ask: What is the exact date the website needs to be live?
- Ask: Could you share one or two websites whose look you like, and say what feels modern and what feels traditional about them?
- Ask: Should customers pay on the website, or only send an order that you confirm and charge yourself?

response_json.summary: Six acceptance criteria were drafted, two of them still to confirm because Brief Decoder flagged them. Settle the launch date and the style direction with the client first, and confirm the target audience.
